spec.scene: A warm coffee shop counter made of polished dark wood sits on a wet tiled floor. In the center, an oversized ceramic mug holds a creamy latte with a frothy cat face etched in the foam. A barista in an olive green apron stands behind the espresso machine, holding a metal pitcher. To the left, an inside-out black umbrella leans against a wooden stool, dripping onto a glossy puddle. Rain streaks glisten along the counter's small back window.
spec.title: A Cat in the Foam
spec.caption: The barista drew a cat in my latte after the storm.
